"""Required synthetic profile values only; no formal policy defaults."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime,timedelta,timezone
from uuid import UUID
from .errors import Denied
SYNTHETIC='SYNTHETIC_TEST_ONLY'
def text(v):
    if type(v) is not str or not v.strip():raise Denied('NONEMPTY_IDENTIFIER_REQUIRED')
    return v
def integer(v,*,zero=False):
    if type(v) is not int or v<(0 if zero else 1):raise Denied('EXPLICIT_INTEGER_PARAMETER_REQUIRED')
    return v
def utc(v):
    if type(v) is not datetime or v.tzinfo is None or v.utcoffset() is None:raise Denied('AWARE_SOURCE_TIME_REQUIRED')
    return v.astimezone(timezone.utc)
def micros(delta):return delta.days*86400000000+delta.seconds*1000000+delta.microseconds
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TimeProfile:
    authority_id:str
    authority_version:str
    profile_version:str
    health_ttl_us:int
    precision_us:int
    offset_limit_us:int
    rollback_tolerance_us:int
    scope:str
    def checked(self):
        for v in (self.authority_id,self.authority_version,self.profile_version):text(v)
        for v in (self.health_ttl_us,self.precision_us):integer(v)
        integer(self.offset_limit_us,zero=True);integer(self.rollback_tolerance_us,zero=True)
        if self.rollback_tolerance_us!=0:raise Denied('NONZERO_ROLLBACK_TOLERANCE_NOT_SELECTED')
        if self.scope!=SYNTHETIC:raise Denied('FORMAL_TIME_HEALTH_PROFILE_AUTHORITY_PENDING')
        return self
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LeaseProfile:
    version:str
    version_authority:str
    engine_ttl_us:dict
    l_max_us:int
    boundary:str
    scope:str
    def checked(self,engine):
        text(self.version);text(self.version_authority);integer(self.l_max_us)
        if self.scope!=SYNTHETIC or self.boundary!='CANDIDATE_HALF_OPEN':raise Denied('FORMAL_LEASE_PROFILE_AUTHORITY_PENDING')
        if type(self.engine_ttl_us) is not dict or engine not in ('E1','E2','E3','E4') or engine not in self.engine_ttl_us:raise Denied('ENGINE_TTL_MISSING')
        ttl=integer(self.engine_ttl_us[engine])
        if ttl>self.l_max_us:raise Denied('TTL_OVER_EXPLICIT_SYNTHETIC_MAX')
        return ttl
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Binding:
    jobId:str
    attemptId:str
    snapshotId:str
    snapshotRevision:str
    sourceRevision:str
    fenceToken:str
    executionEpoch:int
    def checked(self):
        # Internal engineering shape only, not an approved seven-field wire Schema.
        for v in (self.jobId,self.attemptId,self.snapshotId,self.snapshotRevision,self.sourceRevision,self.fenceToken):text(v)
        if type(self.executionEpoch) is not int or not 1<=self.executionEpoch<=9007199254740991:raise Denied('EPOCH_INVALID')
        return self
